description: Convenience 'subscribe': submit a request, poll its status until COMPLETED, then return the result. Consumes fal credits. If it does not complete within the wait budget, returns a { status, request_id, status_url, note } object (NOT an error) so you can keep polling with falai_get_request_status / falai_get_request_result.

input.description: The model's input object — arbitrary params for that model, e.g. { "prompt": "a cat" }. Use falai_get_model_schema to learn the fields.

max_wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for completion (default 60, capped at 300).

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

name: falai_run_model
title: Run model (subscribe)
